# BIC REA LLC — Comprehensive Title Research

> BIC REA LLC delivers institutional-grade comprehensive title research — surface, mineral, and leasehold in one examination — with reports, runsheets, GIS mapping, curative work, and attorney-issued title opinions coordinated through independent licensed counsel, confirmed per state at engagement. Serving energy operators, landmen, attorneys, and royalty owners across 30+ states, with researchers who travel to any courthouse in the country when the records demand it. Based in Sarasota, Florida. Contact: info@bicrea.com · +1 (310) 963-1569.

## Core pages
- [Title Services](https://bicrea.com/title-services): The service catalog — comprehensive title reports, runsheets and abstracts, drilling and division order support, curative work, and attorney-opinion coordination.
- [Methodology](https://bicrea.com/methodology): How examinations are performed — records standards, verification steps, and deliverable formats.
- [FAQ](https://bicrea.com/faq): Common questions on scope, turnaround, pricing structure, and how attorney opinions are coordinated.
- [About](https://bicrea.com/about): Firm background and team.
- [Contact](https://bicrea.com/contact): Engagement inquiries.

## Policies
- [Disclosures](https://bicrea.com/disclosures): Professional disclosures. BIC REA LLC is a title research firm, not a law firm; legal opinions are issued by independent licensed counsel, confirmed per state at engagement.
